architecture: Brain.compose(inputs,7,modules=(64,)); published genes and trace; no action masking
penalty: original waste reward plus -0.24 once per executed invalid choice; clip [-1,1]
persistent: approach-target-v2: existing NavigationService path, 165 px/s, stop at attack range plus LOS, path failure, changed target >40px, 2800ms, or next decision; no fallback
selection: after all training/validation and before any held-out: among affordance/penalty/persistent maximize pooled validation pet damage share, excluding >10pp win loss versus published; ties favor simpler arm; if none eligible choose affordance
curriculum: selected arm; six ten-episode stages: close ready open, medium ready open, far ready open, far cooldown open, obstacles, full randomized. No stage inputs.
pressure: validation-only selected-arm diagnostic; unchanged full training scenarios, owner hit amount multiplied by 0.5; frozen validation and held-out owner combat unchanged
transfer: selected arm and its curriculum: six seed pairs, each direction moon->forest and forest->moon; train60/eval36, training seeds11000/12000, evaluation13000/14000; random/published/reference controls
evaluation: unchanged scenario generator and production-blocked physics; no held-out tuning; private physical probes only after checkpoint frozen
gate: gain >=5pp versus random, paired replica bootstrap 95% lower bound >0, executable rate and pet damage share both above random and published, no factor class >10pp loss versus random, both species and cross-species directions nonnegative win gain, continuation/freeze/immutable-pack tests pass. No owner-carried promotion.
